{"lines":[{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相人之術古矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643200521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孔孟觀人之法，著扵語孟者，豈無權輿與？","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643216905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然以人之吉凶、寿夭、䝿冨、貧賤尽繫扵相者，非","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643233289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330949900844302373"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也；以𠮷凶、壽夭、贵冨、貧賤不繫扵相者，亦非也。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643233289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相有定理，而相面者不能以尽窮也。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643249673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以不能盡穷之見而苟同，如此者𠮷，如此者","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643266057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330949902010236991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫，如此者寿夭、贵冨、貧賎也，豈能皆中㢤？","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643266057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643282441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有相逐心生之说，使非读書窮理之至，安能察人之心如聖賢也。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643282441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近世口傳相人之書，","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643298825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330950103361929267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆宗麻衣道者。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643298825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然人出己見，各有不同。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643315209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至扵即五行之象，以㝎一身之形，因已往之迹，以為方来之驗則同。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643331593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要之無说，固有可取者，","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643347977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330949902010318911"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不必尽出麻衣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643347977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643364361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"守淮楊東充饱君粟之政事之暇，留意無書，首著麻衣之说，復會諸说之宗麻衣者，類輯成編，将以搜之，","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643364361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330950103362125875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專其術，使傳于世，其","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643364361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相，外也；心，内也。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643364361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故聖賢言心不言相。","logicSentenceId":"7641547116380536841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若曰：凶人㐫其𠮷，吉人吉無㐫，相烏足之哉。","logicSentenceId":"7641547116380553225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然則是書，學者不可以不","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643397129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330949902010417215"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知也，不可以尽非也，不可以深泥也。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643397129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賜進士出身、翰林院学士、经筵𧪸官兼脩國史錢塘倪岳書。","logicSentenceId":"7580386529643413513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五代間，有聖人陳摶，宋太祖賜其號曰希夷先生。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025303567","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陳摶，字圖南，自號扶揺子。精相法，𡮢相宋太祖。後乘驢入小路，聞宋太祖卽位，大笑墜地。曰：天下定矣。太祖召至，以野服見，服華陽巾還山，賜號白雲先生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"師麻衣，","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025319951","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃仙翁也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學相，諭以冬深擁爐而敎之。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025319951","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷如期而往，至蕐山石室之中。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025336335","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955839559368767"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蕐山石室，乃麻衣先生修道之地也。後希夷亦隱于此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不以言語而度與，希夷隠而授之也。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723583018","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"但用火筋畫字于爐灰之中，以傳授此賦，又名金鎖賦，又别有銀匙歌，悉皆授之，希夷，盡其學也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦云：相有前定，世無預知。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025352719","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"欲預知相之前定，都非奇妙異常之資不能知。然密授此書者，又豈世俗凡下之人所能解推哉？意必希夷能之者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非神異以秘授，豈塵凡之解推。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025369103","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人之生也，富貴、貧愚，夀夭、福禍、善惡，一定於相之形貌、皮髪、骨格、氣色、聲音焉，世人無有能預知者。惟希夷而巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955907423141903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫舜目重瞳，遂獲禪堯之位；","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025385487","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"舜，虞帝名。瞳目，童子也。舜有重瞳之異相，遂受帝堯之禪而有天下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重耳駢脅，果興霸晉之基。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723599402","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"重耳，晉文公名。駢，幷也。文公有駢脅之奇骨，果興晉室之基，而成霸業也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發石室之丹書，莫忘吾道；剖神仙之古秘，度與希夷。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025401871","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"麻衣謂：今日開發石室冊寶之書，剖破古仙秘奥之傳受爾。希夷，吾之相法，盡於此矣，當念念不忘。可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當知骨格爲一世之榮枯，氣色定行年之休咎。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025418255","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"骨格無異，相之體也，則一世之榮枯，可由此而知。氣色旋生，相之用也，則判行年之休咎，可由此而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955909033705511"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"能。知者叅之，人之貴賤，思過半矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三停平等，一生衣祿無虧。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025434639","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自髪際至印堂，爲上停，山根至于準頭，爲中停，人中至地閤爲下停，此面上三停也。頭、腰、足，爲身上三停也。古云：面上三停，额、鼻、閣。身上三停，足、頭、腰，三停平等。多衣祿；長短如差，福不饒。則衣祿豐虧。於此可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五嶽朝歸，今世錢財自旺。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025451023","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"左顴爲東嶽，右顴爲西嶽，額爲南嶽，地閣爲北嶽，鼻爲中嶽也。此五嶽欲其朝拱豊隆，不宜缺陷傷破。混儀云：五嶽不正，相君終始，薄寒 ；入卦高隆，須是多招財祿。則錢財旺相，於此知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頦爲地閣，見晩歲之規模。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025467407","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955955519143970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"□厚者富饒，尖削者貧薄。凡相人，末限在此地，閣爲水星。屬下停，若推金。水形人，尤準也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻乃財星，管中年之造化，","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025483791","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"豊隆端正者貴顯，掀露斜曲者下賤。凡相人，中限在此。鼻乃土星，屬居中停。若推土形人，最應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額方而濶，初主榮華；骨有削偏，早年偃蹇，","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723615786","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"額爲火星，乃官祿父母之宮，在限爲初，若方正寛濶，必主初年榮華。其骨削偏䧟，須早歲見不利矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目淸眉秀，定爲聰俊之兒；","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025500175","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眉分羅計，目属隂陽。眉宜秀而不粗散低垂，目宜淸而不昏暗斜視，知富貴早，必爲聰明俊秀之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣濁神枯，必是貧窮之漢。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723632170","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相中言神氣最多，人所難辨。觀夫白閣道者云：神氣者，百閱之秀裔也，如陽氣舒而山川秀發。日月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955909033869351"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出而天地清明，在人爲一身之主，諸相之驗。故清鑒云：大都神氣賦於人，有似油兮又似燈，氣神不濁人自富，油清然後燈方明。然則神氣濁枯者，終身不逺之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭高聳，少年富貴，可期。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025516559","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天庭位印堂之上，髪際之下，以其處于至高之位，故曰天庭。宜高聳如立壁，覆肝無瑟紋偏陷，更兼五嶽朝拱，勿必顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣方圓，晩歲榮枯，定取","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025532943","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025532943","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"地閣在承漿之下，颐頦之間，爲田宅奴婢之宫，若方則貴，厚則富可期，薄則貧，方又圓，末主榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"視瞻平正，爲人剛介，平心。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723648554","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"視不欲偏斜，若斜視者，其人奸邪，心必險惡，正視心地坦直，志氣剛介耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955955519340578"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冷笑無情，作事機深，内重","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723664938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723664938","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡與謀爲，惟冷笑而不言情由者，其人機謀必深。而難測，心量必重而不輕也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"準頭豊大心無毒，面肉橫生，性必凶。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723681322","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"準頭爲土星，主乎信。若豊大如獅子截竹者，心必善，如鷹嘴者。性多毒也。○面肉卽顴骨與肉俱露，而横生者，其性必凶暴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723697706","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"智慧生於皮毛，苦樂觀乎手足，","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025549327","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"皮膚細腻光瑩，毛髪踈秀潤澤者，主智慧聰明。若反此者，必粗俗之人也。○手指節枯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025549327","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大粗硬。足背瘦長乾燥者，其人必辛苦；手若細軟潤澤，足若骨肉圓肥者，其人必然逸樂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025549327","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪際低而皮膚粗，終見愚頑。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025565711","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指節細而脚背肥，須知","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723714090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955973093294092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俊雅。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723714090","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"髪際若額而低，皮膚燥枯而粗者，畢竟愚頑之徒也。○指節細潤如春葱，脚背肥豐而有肉者，必俊秀閑雅之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富者自然體厚，貴者定是形殊。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025582095","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"體貌豊隆者，倉庫形相異常而必貴；清奇者，骨格無𧇊而必富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南方貴宦淸高，多主天庭豐濶","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025598479","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025598479","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"南方以天庭爲主，天庭爲額，乃火星也。南方之人，若頭額豊濶而不偏䧟，官禄星得纒，故多爲清高。貴宦人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北方公侯大貴，皆由地閣寛隆。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723730474","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956000381485096"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"北方以地閣爲主，地閣爲頦，乃火星也。北方之人，若頥頦寛隆而朝天庭，若臣相得局，故多爲大貴公矦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重頥豐頷，北方之人貴且强","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025614863","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025614863","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頦頥肥大而若重，兩腮頷濶而如燕頷者，貴相，北人尤强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"駝背面田，南方之人富而足。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723746858","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"駝背豐厚類駝峯，面貌方圓如田字。南方之人有此相者，既云富足矣，觀夫上文有曰：南方貴宦清高，多主天庭，似乎相戾。及觀廣鑒云：浙人俗于清，若面背豐厚，得北方厚重之相，不貴而富矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河目海口，食祿千鍾","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025631247","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025631247","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼爲四瀆之官河也；口爲百納之官海也。自若光明而不露，口若方正而不反，貴顯食祿千鈡，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330955973093490700"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"河目海口者，言有容納而不反露也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鐵面劍睂，兵權萬里","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723763242","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723763242","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鐵面者，神氣黑若鐵色也。劍眉者，稜骨如劍脊也。此相乃羅計橫行於天位，水氣遠居於火方，非兵權萬里之兆歟？言神氣忽變而黒色，定主凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍顔鳳頸，女人必配君王。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723779626","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍貌如龍光之秀異，而頸若彩鳳之非常，乃后妃之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燕頷虎頭，男子定登將相。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025647631","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頷在頦額之問，骨肉豐滿稍起者，如燕頷也。頭頷方圓，口眼俱大，視有威神者，如虎頭也。男子有此者，超羣之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956045130416180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相中訣法，壽夭最難，不獨人中，惟神是定。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025664015","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相書中訣法，惟壽夭爲最難，如郭林宗觀人人法而不及壽夭者，非難，而何？不獨曰人中爲保壽宮。欲分明如破竹之形者，壽，要當以神氣爲之主也。學者宜叅之可矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目長輔采，榮登天府之人；神短無光，早赴幽冥之客。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025680399","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"輔即星輔眉也。采卽光也。若目細長而有神，眉清秀而有光，必聰明登第之士也。○目神短促而無光，視瞻無力而昏暗者，主天折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面皮虗薄，後三十壽難再期","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025696783","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025696783","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"虗者，肉不稱骨也；薄者，有皮而無肉也。故經云：面皮急如鼓，不週三十五。此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肉色輕浮，前四九如何可過。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723796010","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956027199881279"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"肉者，骨之營衛，體之基本也。色者，氣之精粹，神之胎息也。肉宜稱骨而實，色冝有氣而顯，若輕薄浮暗者，必天。故經云：肉緩筋寛色又嫩，三十六前是去程。正此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𩀱絛項下，遇休咎而愈見康强","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025713167","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025713167","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蘭堂左右有兩紋，下至于項首，謂之壽絛，主壽。老人有此絛，苦，遇休囚而不凶，愈見其康吉矣。故經云：眉毫不如耳毫，耳毫不如頃下絛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡骨頂頭中，有疾厄而終無艱險。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723812394","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一作凡骨頂中，葢謂頂額有几貴骨，然人難得俱全，恐非是。終不若凡骨頂中爲有理。但凡奇有奇。骨生於頂中者，雖有疾厄，而終無危險。古云：面無善靨，頭無惡骨，此其証者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨髪旋生，形容忽變，遇吉則推，逢凶可斷，","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025729551","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956045130612788"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫人未貴之先，雖有骨格，既仕之後，旋有形容；未富之前，雖有形容，既富之後，忽有變更，葢骨随貴生，肉隨財長，而形有五行之分。病徃於飽煖，憂出於極樂，其氣有色之變。學者仔細推之，吉㐫可斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常遭疾厄，只因根上昏沉。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723828778","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"根卽山根，位在印堂之下，與年壽上位。如疾病宫，宜神色光明，不欲昏暗。而不明者，常有疾厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頻遇吉祥，","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025745935","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢謂福堂潤澤。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025745935","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"福堂在雨眉之上，華葢之傍，若常明潤而色紅黃者，有吉祥而無凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"涙堂深陷，蠧肉橫生；鼻凖尖垂，人中平滿，尅兒孫之無類，刑嗣續之難逃。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723845162","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下眼眶爲淚堂，宜豐滿，不欲深陷。眶中肉虗若腫，曰蠧肉，不宜横生。鼻尖爲中，宜齊大，不欲尖垂。凖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956027200028735"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下善上，形如破竹而仰者，曰人中，又名曰溝洫。宜深長，不欲平滿。葢淚堂，爲男女子孫之宮，凖與人中乃宫室奴婢之位。若有此破䧟，主兒孫之有剋也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼不哭而淚汪汪，心不憂愁眉縮缩，早無刑剋，老見孤单。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025762319","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若眼不哭泣，而兩淚汪汪而濕，心無憂愁，而雙眉颦縮，此刑尅孤。獨之相也。古云：不哭常如淚，非愁却似愁。憂川常不□，榮樂半途休，學者宜細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面似橘皮，終主貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723861546","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"滿面毛竅如塵垢所拭，云橘皮面是也。百一歌云：面色似橘皮，孤刑定不疑。須然生一子。却換兩重妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956091926331426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神帶桃花，也須皃晚。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723877930","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若神色如桃花，嬌嫩邪淫，此等之人，恐生子不早也。○鬼谷詩云：桃花色重仍侵目，戀酒迷花寵外妻，信乎生子必晚矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肩峩聲泣，不賤則孤。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025778703","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻若梁低，非貧則夭。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723894314","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"肩不欲聳而若寒，聲不欲散而似哭。有此二者，貧賤孤刑之相。○鼻梁乃年壽之位，不宜低凹。有若此者，必傷財壽，非貧則夭。古云：山根斷，凖頭高，到老受設淘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴多生勞漉，爲下停長。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025795087","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中停長遇君王，上停長幼善祥，下停長老吉昌。三停平等，富貴綿綿。若下停長者，未須富貴，未免平。生勞漉也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956081977442345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧窮到老不閑。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723910698","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"粗其骨格。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025811471","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用骨格宜隆晉淸明，與氣肉相滋者，乃富貴安逸之相。若暴露粗大，氣肉不稱者，必貧窮奔波。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星辰失䧟，部位偏虧，無隔宿之儲糧，有終身之勞苦。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723927082","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如眼爲日月而不明，鼻為土星而不隆，此星辰之失陷也。餘皆傲此。額位乎天，宜高而反低；額位乎地，宜厚而反薄，此部位之偏虧也。餘亦傲此。相有如此，貧賤孤苦，終身芳漉，而無隔宿之糧也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三光明旺，財自天來；六府高强，一生富足。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025827855","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兩福星及準頭曰三光，若明淸而不暗，主有天財大吉。餘謂五是即三光。○兩顴、兩頰、兩額角曰天府，若豐隆朝拱者，不貴，必然定爲富矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅光滿面，發財，家自安康。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723943466","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956091926511650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五色惟白黑宜秋冬，青宜春，獨紅黄四季皆吉。若滿面常帶紅黃之色者，發财安康之福相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸脂砑光，尅子，終無成日。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723959850","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"諸脂者，即面若塗膏也。砑光者，即帛用砑石、砑光之類也。面色有如此者，名爲沐浴大維，多主刑尅。子孫之相也，孛者，宜細推之可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面皮太急，雖溝洫長而壽亦虧。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723976234","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若面皮與肉俱急，如綳鼓，雖然人中深，終無壽之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩目無神，縱鼻梁高，而壽亦促。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088723992618","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼爲上相，以神爲主，骨法次之。若目神光，縱使鼻梁髙聳，亦非壽相之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼光如水，男女多淫。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025844239","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂卓如刀，陣亡兵死。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724009002","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956081977589801"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼光，睛之神光也。常要明静，不冝戾濕。故經云：眼濕多淫慾，為元定不祥。又云：光不欲射外，神不欲流出。若目如水，兼邪視者，邪淫人也。○睂爲羅計，其骨勢□竪似刀者，性燥好勇，終主暴亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂生二𧢲，一生快樂無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724025386","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"目秀𠜍形，敢取中年遇貴。二睂俱有兩尾如角而起者，不貴，則安闕之人。○兩目細長，若𠜍形，黑白分明而清秀者，中年顯貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄氣發從高廣，旬日内必定轉官，黑色横自三陽，半","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025860623","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年期，須防損壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025860623","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"黄氣，喜色也。高廣，傍太陽近邉也。此位若黄氣見者，必遷官。庶人有此氣者，亦主喜慶吉兆。○三陽在目之下，若黑氣見此位者，須防身灾不逺，亦防子疾，與女人在右。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奸門靑慘，必主妻災。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025893391","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年壽赤光，多生膿血。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025909775","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956133814878208"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"奸門位在魚尾後，爲要妾宮。若青黑之色見此位者，必妻亥有灾。○年壽二宮在鼻準之上，山根之下，爲疾厄宮，若紅赤之色見此位者，主生瘡疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白氣如粉，父母川傷；靑色侵顴，兄弟唇舌。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025926159","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白氣主丧□，若在父母宮見者，必主刑傷。○顴位正面者，靑色，侵此位者，主兄弟辰舌之憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根靑黑，四九前後定多災；法令綳纒，七七之數焉可過。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724041770","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山根位在年之上，若此位常有靑黑之色者，其年主災疾。○蘭臺之傍曰法令，又名金縷，又名壽帶。宜顯順，若綳急而不顯，纒曲而不順，兼若騰蛇鎖唇而入口者，皆不壽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女子眼惡，嫁卽刑夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025942543","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲刹面橫，閨房獨宿。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025958927","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956133584142377"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"女人之眼，宜細長而淸秀，若圓大凹露，則惡相顯然，便爲刑夫之格矣。○若聲似破鑼，面肉橫生者，必主寡居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額尖耳反，雖三嫁而未休；顴露聲雄，縱七夫之不了。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724058154","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古云：顧失削耳反，乃三夫之婦也。○古云：尅婿兩賴露，刑夫額不平。要知二度嫁女作丈夫聲，亦此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額偏不正，内淫而外貌若無；步走不正，外好而中心最惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025975311","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頭額爲諸陽之首，不宜偏削。若偏而不正，及舉止輕浮而不穩重者，多主淫蕩。○行歩不平，正如風柳，乃蛇行雀躍之相，主心地險惡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956175871066146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腮見耳後，心地狡貪；眼惡鼻","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025991695","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾，中心險毒。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143025991695","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"腮即頤也，頤骨不宜太濶露。古云：耳後見垂腮，平生無徃來，必主心地狡猾贪鄙。○古云：眼若凸露。人情難睦，鼻如鷹嘴，喫人心髓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚根不着地，賣盡田園而走他。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724074538","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鄕。行歩爵重，富而財豐。若行歩輕浮不停，如雀躍之状者，爲破財奔彼之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻竅露而仰，卒被外災，而終旅舎。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143026008079","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：鼻仰辰孤及結喉，夭亡限跡，而走他鄉，正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇不葢齒，無事招嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143026024463","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"溝洫露。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143026040847","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此爲人少力。不笑而齒龈常露者，好談人過，與衆不和。經曰：齒䟱唇露不合口。唇尖薄是□多，故招人嫌。正謂此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956133584306217"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。○溝洫卽人中不宜無髭，若少髭而人中露者，其人主一生勞碌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂太窄，子晩妻遲；懸壁昏暗，入亡家破。","logicSentenceId":"7580341143026057231","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印堂宜豐隆，太窄，若此者，不惟無宫，抑且妻子不早○，懸壁爲奴婢。宫宜光潤，若氣色昏暗者，主死亡破敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"結喉露齒，骨肉分離。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859684387","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"粗骨急皮，壽年短促，","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859700771","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"細侯者，喉骨若光圓而高顯也。露齒者，即唇不葢齒也。二者乃客死。招嫌之相，而骨肉分離，不亦宜乎。○骨格粗大而露，皮肉急緊而帶薄，此皆爲夭壽之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形容俊雅，終作高賢。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724090922","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨格淸奇，必須貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724107306","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"容若桂林之一枝，崑山之片玉，清奇正雅者，必爲上等之人，非凡相也。○精神翹秀，曰古怪異。非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956175871246370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"常曰：奇有此清奇之骨格，終須貴達。先正有云：峩峩古怪若閑雲，崑山片玉已琢成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卧𧖟豐下，定子息之晩成；淚堂平滿，須兒郎之早","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859717155","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859717155","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卧蠶在眼下，爲子息宮，若豊下而陷者，主生子必晚成。○淚堂即眼眶也，若肉生豐滿而不坑陷者。生子必早招。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍宫低黑，嗣續難得而愚昧；隂陽眼潤，男女易養而聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859733539","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"隂陽，即三隂三陽，亦子息宮也。若光明潤澤而不枯䧟者，必主男女易養而聰明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面大鼻小，一生常自歷艱辛；鼻瘦面肥，半世錢財終耗散。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859749923","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956195294920723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正面雖大，而土星獨小，奔波之相也。廣記云：鼻小爲四極，農作無休息。○面肥鼻隆，錢財豐充。若面肥鼻雖高尖而瘦者，縱有錢財，終須耗散。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邊地四起，過五十始遂亨通；輔骨隆高，纔三九則居官從。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724123690","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"邊地與大庭、山林、郊外俱高聳者，正晚年榮祿之相。○輔骨即雨輔角，玄骨□也。若聳起而隆高，必早年榮逹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明珠出海，","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859766307","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太公八十遇文王。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859766307","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一本增作明珠出朝大海。觧明珠爲耳垂珠，意謂明珠朝口爲壽相，然與下文不合，葢太公八十遇。言發達之遲。馬周三十逢唐帝，言發達之早。文王若人色鳶肩，馬周之相，以火能炎上，鳶能飛騰，發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956218170703912"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逹之早宜矣。若明珠出海爲太公之相，則未明，缺疑可也。子觀下文有曰：流龜放海，須防水厄之災。謂黑氣入口，恐明珠出海，亦指氣色而言，學者詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火色鳶肩，","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859782691","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬周三十逢唐帝。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859782691","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"唐帝乃太宗也，火色，赤氣也。鳶，鴟類，飛則肩聳。馬周赤色而聳肩，其相如此，故早年騰達，葢飛而炎上，早發達也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鶴形龜息，","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859799075","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洞賔之遇僊得僊。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859799075","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鶴形清奇，龜息異常，呂洞賔有此相，至廬山遇鍾離眞人，一夢黃粱而得仙道。息者，氣息也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍腦鳳睛，","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859815459","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄齡之拜相人","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859815459","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859815459","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍腦者，頭角巉巖高起而顯露也。鳳睛者，兩目細長，黑白分明而光彩也。房玄齡有此相，故唐太宗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956195295084563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時人相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法令人口，鄧通餓死野人家。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724140074","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"法令者，口邊紋也。詳見前註。前漢鄧通有此紋，文帝令諸負相之，指其口曰：他日當餓死。帝曰：富貴在朕，遂賜通蜀道鋼山，得自鑄錢。後至章帝罷銭，通竟餓死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"騰蛇鎖唇，梁武餓亡臺城。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724156458","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"騰蛇，卽法","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"令紋也。梁武帝亦有此紋，帝都建康，爲侯景過臺城，飮膳被侯景裁損，帝憂深成疾，口苦。索蜜不得，再曰：可呵。遂殂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎頭燕頷，班超封萬里之侯。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724172842","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"虎頭燕頷，解見前。許負相班超曰：燕頷虎頭，飛而食肉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859831843","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"萬里矦相也。後果投筆出玉門關，立大功，威","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956218170916904"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"震西戊，後封爲定遠矦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎歩龍行，","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859848227","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劉裕至九重之位。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859848227","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"虎歩行而濶，龍行不動身也。經云：虎行位至侯王。劉裕，字德與，彭城人，有此相。元熈二年，授晉禪，號宋武帝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山林骨起，終作神仙。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724189226","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山林在郊外，髮際之間，有骨而高起者，以其貴在日月天庭之外，故但作神仙而去。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金城骨分，限登將相。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859864611","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印堂有骨隆起，分如五指，貫入髪際，曰金城。人若有此骨者，主大貴。經曰：金城分五指，極品在巖廊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又當知貴賤易失，限數難𠫵。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859880995","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956253637722131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"骨格貴賤貧富，相所易識，若夫氣色生尅之限數，實難𠫵詳也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣死生之期，先看形神，定吉凶之兆，莫逃氣色。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859897379","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人之一身，以神氣爲主，形貌次之。凡相人之法，神與氣色爲要。神有生旺，氣色有生尅。詳而觀之，則吉凶定，死生决矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睛如魚目，速死之期。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859913763","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣若𤎆雲，凶","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859930147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"災日至","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859930147","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。睛圓露而癡者，則如魚目。有如此相，又無光彩，非壽○氣。色宜光彩，不欲昏暗。若氣色如烟塵所蒙，而昏暗者，必主凶災之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形如土偶，天命難逃。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724205610","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天柱傾欹，幻身將去。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859946531","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形如枯乾，與土無異者，不久病亡。○天柱者，頸項也。若項傾欹歪而莫起者，虗幻之軀，必見將死之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956267671978018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貌如鎪鐵，運氣連邅。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859962915","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色若祥雲，前程亨㤗。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724221994","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鎪鐵䤭金曰：鎪鐵，言其踈薄也。一身氣色若此𨃀薄者，其氣運不通。○氣明潤祥雲面紅黃者，前程必通泰也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名成利遂，","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859979299","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三台宫俱有黃光。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029859979299","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文滯書難，","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860012067","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩眉頭各生靑氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860012067","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三台卽在兩輔及額角，此位俱有黄氣者，利名成遂。○眉頭即輔角也，其氣靑黑色。文書必遲，滯也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄氣少而滯氣重，功名來又不來。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724238378","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"紅黄者，喜氣也；青黑者，滯氣也。若紅黃之色少，靑黑之氣多者，求功名必有而無也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956253637869587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青氣少而喜氣多，富貴至而又至。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724254762","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"紅黄之色，滿面而無滯。氣，財祿叠至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滯中有明，憂而變喜；明中有滯，吉而反凶。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724271146","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"氣若滯而忽明澗者，憂中必有喜氣；若明而忽暗滯者，吉中必有凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正面有紅光，無不遂意。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724287530","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂多喜氣，謀無不通。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724303914","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正面一寸三分，印堂在闗門之間，二部若有紅黄紫喜氣者，謀爲多。主遂意之兆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年壽潤明，一歲平安。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860028451","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年壽在山根之下，爲疾厄宮。若光明不暗者，其年必平安。一作懸壁無光，財寳將去，甲櫃潤澤，吉祈鼎來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956309568733218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱光澤，諸吉鼎來。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860044835","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金匱，鼻凖頭兩傍，即蘭掌庭尉，若明潤不暗者，主吉而不凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"部位無虧，一生平穩。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724320298","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色有滯，終見凶連。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724336682","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一生部位無虧破者，不遭凶險；諸位氣色不光潤者，終有不利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形容古怪，石中有美玉之藏。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860061219","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形相古怪者，不可作下賤看。若神氣清秀，動丘異常，乃濁中淸也，非石中之美玉乎？學者詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人物巉巖，海底有明珠之聚。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724353066","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如龍凖、龍頭、虎頭、虎晴之類，豈非巉巖之人物乎？終遇貴顯，不可一列而推，眞若滄海之珠也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要之，一辯其色，次聽其聲，更察夫神，再觀乎脾肉，不","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860077603","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956310734766119"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可忽也。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860077603","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四者兼之。萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉毛拂天倉，出入近貴。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724369450","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印堂接中正，終須利官。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860093987","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天倉往眼角傍，若眉如新月而拂天倉，主聰明近貴之相。○若印堂寛隆，上接中正而光潤者，必利乎官也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"呼聚喝散，只因雙顴竝起於峯巒；引是招非，葢謂兩唇不遮乎牙道。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724385834","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"東西二嶽曰：雙顴、王威權。峯巒，言隆高也。若二顴隆高，其人有聚散之威。○唇不葢齒，好說是非之人也，豈不自招是引非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者哉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956309568913442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狼行虎吻，機深而心事難明。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860110371","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"行而頭低及反顧曰：狼行，無事咬牙。若怒而無笑容者曰虎吻。其人凶狠心機，心難明也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猴食䑕飡，鄙吝而奸謀到底。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724402218","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"食而細疾，其貌如懼者，曰鼠飡；食而不嚼，其貎如不足者，曰猴食。有如此者，必鄙怪吝奸狡之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭先過歩，初主好，晚景貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860126755","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竈仰撩天，中限敗，田園","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860143139","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耗散。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860143139","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"行若頭低向前過歩者，其人必然初年有餘，末年不足也。○井竈乃鼻竅也，不宜仰露，若仰露而撩天，主中年而破散。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人耳反，亦主刑夫。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860159523","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子頭尖，終無成器。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724418602","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956310734929959"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木金二星失纒，不利夫宮，兼有九醜孀居，女人之相也。○頭乃六陽之首，終宜圓大，若尖小者，豈富貴之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀貴人之相，非止一途。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860175907","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"察朝士之形，俱要四大。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860192291","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四大即四體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰圓背厚，方保玉帶朝衣；骨聳神清，定主威權忠節。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724434986","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"腰腹圓肥，肩背豊厚，皆衣祿之人，貴相也。○骨格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/27/ref/1lvqvq6z3w1s9/1-7603965355653365796_%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%874.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=XHNIUBIvY2%2BlDVS0yia9QN%2BV3s4%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/27/ref/1lvqvq6z3w1s9/1-7603965355653365796_图片4.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7603966443415142436"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巖而高聳，眼神清光而有權，若居官必有威，忠節之臣也，觀夫下文可驗之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏犀貫頂，一品王侯；輔骨挿天，千軍勇將。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724451370","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若負骨自印堂聳入於腦者，曰伏犀，主大貴也。輔骨在眉角，有骨豊肥，挿入天倉者，必主威權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956357501288483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形如猪相，死必分屍；眼似虎晴，性嚴莫犯。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860208675","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"體肥貧短，飮食無厭。目朦朧而黑白不分明者，猪相也，多死非命。○目圓大而有神，視不轉而有威音虎睛，其人之性必燥烈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬚黄睛赤，終主橫屍；齒露唇掀，須防野死。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724467754","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"古云：眼睛赤，心性急；髭鬚黃，怒氣强，終招災禍。○兩唇不遮牙，道曰露齒。若唇掀喉結，必死他鄕之郊野。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口唇皮皺，爲人一世孤单；魚尾多紋，到老不能安逸。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860225059","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"通仙錄云：口邊皮若生皺褶，有子應須出外鄕，豈不孤单？○魚尾在眼角之上，經云：魚尾笏紋長入口，雖有眉壽最勞心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956364753207337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二眉散亂，須憂聚散不常；兩目雖雄，必主富而多詐。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860241443","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眉乃兄弟姊妹宮，亦主財星，若散不淸，主離耗。○目一大一小曰雌雄，有如此者，雖然財富必多詭詐也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面多斑㸃，恐非老壽之人；耳有毫毛，定是長生之客。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724484138","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"黑青班㸃生於面者，神氣衰也，豈能壽乎？○經云：眉毫不如耳毫，耳毫不如項下條，皆壽相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脚背無肉，必主孤貧；胸上生毛，性非寛大。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860257827","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大繞賦云：足者身之枝，所以運諸身者也。若枯而無肉者，必孤貧跋渉之人也。○胸堂上生毛者，性偏急。經云：身上生毛非達器。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫敎四反五六，必主凶亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860274211","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更忌神昏八九也，無稱意。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860290595","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956406071246848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四反者，口無棱，眼無神，中露竅，耳無輪也。右此四反。其上去有凶言之事，○有此四反，更兼神。氣昏暗者，至老終不稱意老。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天庭高濶，須知僕馬無虧。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860306979","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"前文云：天庭高聳，少年富貴可期。此云高與濶，言其高而且濶，定居官位而無疑也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地閣方圓，必主錢財堆積。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724500522","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"地閣方圓得乎地，天庭豐備得乎天。得乎天者，必貴，得乎地者，必主於富也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臉上淸光級級，貪婪孤貧；","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860323363","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凖頭赤色重重，奔波詭計。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860323363","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"臉上青黑之色疊見者，主孤苦不足。○土星有火，萬物不生之相，主奔波。若酒後而赤詭計","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860339747","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圓融小巧，畢竟豐亨；方正神舒，終須穩耐。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724516906","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956364753371177"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五短之形，融和而奇巧者，至老而富㤗豐亨也。○面目之正而有神氣者，終必穩重堅耐而吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手脚粗大，難爲富貴之從；齒鼻齊豐，定亨庄田之客。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860356131","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"手脚粗大，貧賤之相。無肉而露筋，安能富貴？○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"齒齊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而密，鼻大而豐者，安享田庄之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手軟如綿，閑且有錢；掌若血紅，富而多祿。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860372515","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：手若綿軟，富可羙。色若譔紅祿。不絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉抽二尾，一生常自足歡娛。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724533290","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"前云眉生两角者，謂頭秀起如角也，但一生快樂而已。此云眉抽二尾，謂眉首尾齊秀如新月也。其人多戀花酒，一生自樂之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"根有三紋，中主必然多耗散","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860388899","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956406071476224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860388899","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山根若有三紋侵斷者，多主耗散。廣記云：山根若有橫紋斷，尅子刑妻少弟兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳白過面，朝野聞名。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724549674","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"袖裏經云：耳白過面，終爲名臣。昔歐陽公未貴，有僧相曰：公耳白過面，名聞天下，後官至宰相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神稱於形，情懷舒暢。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860405283","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"精神者，乃人一身之根本，貴于形神相稱，不宜偏足。若形與神俱完，足而不偏者，心身安㤗之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足生黑子，英雄獨壓萬人。","logicSentenceId":"7606693088724566058","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"左足男吉，右足女吉。且昔安祿山少賤事張守珪，爲之濯足，少停之而不言。守珪問之曰：節度足底有黑子，故少停。珪曰：吾之貴者，在此痣也。祿山拜曰：不肖雙足俱有。守珪優待之。使祿領三處節度使，如此驗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956416020152339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨挿邊庭，威武名揚四海。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483039238","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"邊庭在輔𧢲髮際之間，若額聳起入邊地者，主武貴。廣鑑云：驛馬連邊地，兵權主一方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲自丹田下出，有福而亨遐齡。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483055622","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丹田在臍下，若發自臍下來者，音韻聲遠，主壽。希夷論曰：衆人之息以喉，貴人之息以臍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨從腦後橫生，發財且增長壽。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483072006","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"腦後有骨橫生者，名曰玉枕，主富壽也。廣鑑云：骨自腦生少人知，贵祿緜緜福夀期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地庫光潤，晚景愈好而得安閑；懸璧色明，家宅無憂而多喜慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860421667","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"地庫在兩頥，若光潤華彩，末主稱心快意。○懸璧解見前，若氣不暗者，吉而無凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956446156374051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土星薄而山林重，滯氣多災；前相好而背負虧，虗名無壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860438051","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻小","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂之土薄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬚多謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山林重，若更有滯氣，必主多災。○前面形相雖好，而後背形相虧䧟不稱者，名壽不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂隲肉滿，福重心靈；","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860454435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正面骨開，粟陳貫朽。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860454435","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"隂隲卽淚堂之位。若豐滿不橫出者，必聰壽之相也。○正面卽兩顴也。若骨開潤而不偏陷者，廣積財穀之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𩯭毛毬織，或先富而後貧；筋若蚓蟠，定少閒而多厄。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483088390","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若髪𩯭濁亂如織毬者，其人性懶，縱財富而後必貧；○額面手足青筋亂生者，曰蚓蟠，主辛苦不閑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956416020267027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而多厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉稜骨起，縱有壽而孤刑；項下結喉，恐無兒而客死。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860487203","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眉骨巉巖，雖云古怪，若眉稜獨起者，雖有壽亦孤刑。○結喉，解見前。經云：齒露結喉，死在他州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼如雞目，性急難容；歩若蛇行，毒而無壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860503587","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼圓小而黃如雞目，其性急燥，然多淫而有破害。○行而頭足俱動，作三折狀者，曰蛇行。輕而心毒。安能有壽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色靑横於正面，喚作行屍；色黑横於耳前，名爲奪命。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483104774","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"額上眼下曰正面若青氣横生，此位者，主有災疾。故曰行屍。○耳前爲命門若有黑色，侵者有病必難療。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956483347218466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑遮口角，扁鵲難醫；黑掩太陽，盧醫莫救。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860519971","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"口爲人之司命，若兩角青黑，非吉兆，病人難治。○太陽，左目也；盧醫、扁鵲，名翳。掩黑太陽，䧟乎雙目，名醫莫能治。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白如枯骨，亦主身亡；黑若濕灰，終須壽短。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860536355","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若病人有白氣如枯骨者，本無生氣，有死而已。○又有黒氣，若濕灰之色者，豈長壽乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪而恒難，只因滿面悲容，天更多災，","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860552739","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢謂山根薄削。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860552739","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"容顔常若哭狀，必主貧而多難。經云：不醉却如醉，非愁却以愁。笑驚癡騃様，榮樂好途休。○年壽山根䧟薄而尖削，主疾病而夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平主少疾。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483121158","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆因月孛光隆，到老無災。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860585507","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵年宮潤澤。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860601891","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956416020414483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年壽卽月孛星，此位豐隆有光，平生必少疾病也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"血不華色，少遂多憂；行不動身，積財有壽。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483137542","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"血以養氣，氣以養神，色無光華，中心不足，豈無憂愁乎？○行歩而身不動者，謂端莊貴重之相也，豈無財壽者乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神光滿面，富貴稱心；鬼色見形，貧愁度日。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483153926","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神光者，色紅黄而有光也。鬼色者，氣青黑而多暗也。故而有神光，利名多遂；而有鬼色者，貧愁即至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病淹目閉，有神無色者生；神脫口開，天柱傾欹者死。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483170310","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"病人雖目閉，有神無色者，必主生。○若眼無神光，口開項倒者，必死天柱傾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五嶽俱正，人可延年；七竅不明，壽難再乆。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860618275","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956516385718324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五嶽註見前。若俱正而不偏斜者，固爲壽相。○若耳目、口鼻之七竅反露而不明者，亦主夭折","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483186694","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢黑色，必主卒灾；天庭靑氣，須防瘟疫。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860634659","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"華葢謂福堂之間，黑氣侵之，主有暴疾。天庭在天中之下，青氣生之主，有瘟疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤燥生於地閣，定損牛羊；青白起於奸門，禍侵妻妾。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860651043","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"地閣爲奴僕宮，若生赤氣如火而燥者，損牛羊。○奸門在眼角之前。若有青白二氣，恐妻妾有災奸門乃妻宫是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽火旺，必主誕男；三陰木多，定須生女。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860667427","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三陽在左，眼下紅氣旺，必生男；三陰在右，眼下靑氣䏑，即生女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483203078","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流𩲸放海，須防水厄之災；遊𩲸守宮，定主喪身之苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860683811","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956478200774695"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"流𩲸、遊䰟，皆黑色也。大海爲口，有黒氣入口者，○須防水厄宫，即龍宫眼𭿍也。若生黑氣，定然多主身喪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道路昏慘，防跌跌之災；宫室燥炎，恐火湯之咎。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860700195","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"道略，卽通關委巷也。若生滯氣，陟陰不利。○宮室在竈厨之傍，若生紅燥之氣。須防湯火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳根黑子，倒死路傍；承漿深紋，恐投浪裏。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860716579","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"耳後生黑子者，主客死他鄉。○承漿在唇下。若生深紋，必主有水厄之災也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼堂豐厚，亦主貪淫；人中偏斜，亦多刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860732963","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼堂固宜豐滿，若豐而加厚，亦主貪淫。○人中固宜顯正，若有偏斜者，亦主刑尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860749347","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼牙尖露，詭譎奸貪；神者崢嶸，凶豪惡死。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483219462","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956551559053346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"當門牙固宜齊夫而平，固主誠信。若傍齒尖露者。鬼于其人，必多詭貪。○一眉豐隆。固爲壽相，若稜骨高削，性必豪凶，恐非大命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人形似鬼，衣食不豐；生相若仙，平生閑逸，","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860765731","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人形古怪，固爲貴相，若形貌如鬼者，雖有衣食，必不豐也。○形貌淸而日秀異若仙人之狀，非貴必主安閑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榖道亂毛，號作淫秒。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483235846","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳根高骨，名曰壽堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860782115","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"糞門多毛，皆由膀胱氣之盛而生，此人必主多淫。○耳後骨起，名曰：壽堂。經云：欲知人壽考，耳大玉樓城。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨格精神痩亦可取肉，地濁浮肥，何足誇。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860798499","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956478200938535"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"骨格雖瘦，而氣色有神者，有可收之吉。皮肉雖肥，而不堅潤者，有不取之凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目多四白，主孤剋而兒亡；鼻有三凹，必貧窮而孤苦。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483252230","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼如怒睜而露四白者，孤刑凶亡之相也。○三凹者，目山根至凖而有三曲折也，主破敗刑尅之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三尖六削，縱奸巧而貧賤；四方五端，須不謀而富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483268614","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三尖，謂頭凖閣尖小也。六削，謂眉目耳口削薄也。又謂之六惡，主貧賤而好巧也。○兩天倉地庫方。滿而不䧟，五岳端拱而不偏者，富貴不求而自來也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腿長脚瘦，當年奔走不停；唇薄口尖，好說是非無了。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483284998","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"腿脛細長，周背枯瘦，月辛苦之相也。○嘴小尖削，兩唇掀薄，好說是非之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"部位伶俐，自然無禍無災；紋痣交加，到底有嗟有怨。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483301382","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956551559299106"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"部位分明而不駁襍者，吉祥。紋痣亂生於各位者，凶○紋痣交加者，㐫禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"峩肩鼠食，非惟吝而且貪；劍鼻蜂睛，不特凶而又賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860814883","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"峩肩卽肩聳，䑕食訓見前。有此二相者，主貧吝而凶。○鼻梁固而如劍，眼晴露而不𨍭，如蜂日者，性暴下賤之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫孩童易養，聲大有神，夭折難成，","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860831267","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腎浮不緊。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860831267","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以下數條，諭小兒相小兒初生，啼聲大而有神色者，有病而易養。腎囊虗浮而不緊者，多疾而必夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭圓骨聳，易養而利益𩀱親；額方面濶，無險而吉祥迭至。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860864035","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頭圓而無模，骨聳而入格，主富賈，豈不易養而利於父母乎。○額骨方隆面容開濶者，吉多凶少。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956545313800231"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根青色，出胎而頻見災厄；年上黑光，㓜歲而多生膿血。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860880419","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山根年壽，有靑黑氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㓜小多生災疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽囊若荔殻，定爲堅耐之兒；面肉類浮漚，决是虗花之子。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860896803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"腎囊堅實而若荔枝殻者，堅固耐病之兒。○面内虗肥而薄如浮漚狀者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃虗花難育之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭尖無腦骨，能言而亡；目緩少精神，將行而死。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860929571","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頭尖小而腦骨低䧟，眼緩慢而精神不足者，難存也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色緊肉實，可養無虞；聲響氣淸，端爲頴異。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860945955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956589614170112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"顔色明緊，皮肉堅實者，可保無與。聲音響亮，神氣淸爽者，爲人異衆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻梁低塌，當生啾唧之災；髪際壓遮，定是孤刑之子。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483317766","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年壽低䧟，乃病官不足，故多災厄也。○髪若遮額壓眉者，多主孤刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860962339","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪齊額廣，英俊聰明；氣短聲低，糊塗夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860978723","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬂髪整齊，天庭廣濶者，主聰秀。氣息短促。聲音低小者，主愚夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亂郊挿額，利處山林；正面無權，難居宅舍。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483334150","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"外郊在山林之下，有骨接額者，隠逸之人，幽閑之客。○面無顴骨，其人無威，治家不嚴，可以獨居而無施","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤峰獨聳，骨内參商；四尾低垂，妻兒隔角。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029860995107","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956545313931303"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻高面四岳低者，六親不和；眉眼而四垂者，妻子少息，而隔角不相和","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"睦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
