{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亂紋額上，男女竝主孤刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861011491","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黑痣淚堂，子息恐云有尅。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861027875","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"額橫三紋，固爲壽相，多而亂子，主孤苦刑尅之相。○兩眼下為淚堂，兒女宮也。若生黑子。忍多刑尅兒女也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483350534","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉不葢眼，財親離散之人；眼大露睛，壽促夭凶之子。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861044259","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"目長眉短而不覆者，亦主孤貧。管輅云：目長眉短不相附親者，如疎自用心。○古云目大露睛，其性必凶，豈有壽乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上輕下重，末主伶仃；上濶下尖，終無結果。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861060643","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額尖鼻小，側室分居；喉結脚長，終臨外處。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861077027","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956622782677026"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下亭輕薄，上停厚重者，末主孤苦。身上二停上濶而下尖削者，亦然。○鼻額尖小者，固不和於家，結喉而脚長者。客死於外。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有權有柄，皆因兩臉有權；無識無能，只爲雙眉不秀。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861093411","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"已上二等，其文異而理則一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭白過面，衣食豐盈；","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861109795","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神賽於形，庄田榮足。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861109795","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"面粗身細，一身富貴。形神相付，一身榮足，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男兒腰細，難主福財；女子肩寒，孤刑再嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483366918","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以下數條，言女人之相也。男子腰細不豐者，福必薄，女人肩寒似縮者，命必毒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483383302","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭大額大，終主刑夫；聲粗骨粗，竟爲孀婦。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861126179","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956545313996839"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若女人頭額俱大，聲音粗濁。骨多肉少，皆孤刑之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼光口濶，貪淫求食之人；擺手摇頭，詭濫刑夫之婦。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861142563","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼露光而口濶大者，貪淫度日；頭首輕揺而不重者，濫淫刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪濃𩯭重，兼斜視以多淫；聲響神淸，必益夫而得食。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861158947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"髪濃𩯭重而視瞻不正，血氣旺而心必邪，主淫蕩之相。○聲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"音響亮，眼神淸明者，益夫食祿之婦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根不斷，必得賢夫；部位停勻，應招貴子。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861191715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻梁不斷者，配必佳；部位不偏者，子必有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨格細膩，富貴自主淸閒；髪𩯭粗濃，勞苦終爲貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861208099","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"骨肉相稱細膩者淸閒，髪𩯭低亂濁而粗濃者，辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956657981227060"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皮膚香膩，乃富室之女娘；面色端嚴，必豪門之德婦。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483399686","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"皮肉淸香而細膩者，面色潤潔而端嚴者，貴富之婦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪細光潤，禀性溫良；神緊眼圓，爲人急燥。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861224483","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"髪細微而有光者，氣必和而性良；神緊而目圓者，氣必急而性燥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二顴高凸，刑夫未了期年；兩耳反薄，尅子終無成。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483416070","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"口","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"顴骨高削者，刑夫不定；耳若反而薄者，尅子無休口。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手粗脚大，必是姨婆；鼻尖額低，終爲侍妾。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861240867","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"手脚粗大者，巫姨、媒婆之相；鼻額尖低者，姬妾之形。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卧蠶明潤而紫色，必產貴兒；甲匱豐腴而黄光，終興","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861257251","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956545314045991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家道。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861257251","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼下有肉如卧蠶而紫色者，必生貴子而主福也。○金甲二匱在鼻兩傍，若豐腴而黃色光明，必旺家也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人口濶，先食田庄而後貧；美女背圓，必嫁秀士而得貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861273635","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"女人之口濶大而無收食者，貪食懶作，而後貧乏也。○背若圓厚而淸秀者，必配良夫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身肥肉重，得隂相而反榮華；面圓腰肥，類男形而亦富。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861290019","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身體肥澤而肉不虗浮，貌稱女形者，主榮貴之相也。○女人腰腹肥垂似男子者，主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956693171470376"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾姜之手，女子必善持家；綿囊之拳，男子定興財産。","logicSentenceId":"7580342029861306403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"女人皮肉固宜細潤，惟手指瘦實不露肉者，善持家。○若男子腕如綿軟，不求自富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭小腹大，一生不過多食；骨少肉多，三十焉能可過。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483432454","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"女人頭小腹大者，不過多食若又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"肉有餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而骨不足者，定主天亾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉粗眼惡，頻數刑夫；聲雄氣濁，終無厚福。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445048867","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眉粗亂而眼惡露者，尅夫；聲雄大而氣濁相者貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼光如醉，桑中之約無窮；媚靨漸生，月下之期難定。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445065251","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼露光而神如醉者，多淫慾；野合之人，笑多嬌媚者，下賤之婦也，經云：媚靨漸生非良婦，豈無月下之期乎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956612028416041"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面如滿月，家道興隆；唇若紅蓮，衣食豐足。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445081635","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"面色光潤而無缺陷，唇如抹丹而不尖露者，主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根黑子，若無宿疾，必刑夫。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483448838","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下皺紋，亦主六親。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445098019","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若氷炭。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445114403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"黑子生于山根者，身無久疾，夫必刑。○亂紋侵于眼下者，身孤而骨肉踈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齒如榴子，衣食豐盈；鼻若竈門，家財罄盡。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483465222","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"齒密，光潔如榴子，富足也。〇鼻竅仰露者，主貧乏也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形如羅漢，見子必遲；貌若判官，得兒尤晩。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445130787","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形貌古怪如羅漢、判官者，子生遲晩之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956723831849000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三山突濶，萬頃規模；四瀆清明，終生福氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445147171","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"額與兩顴高濶者，閎遠發逹之相也。耳目口鼻淸明者，廣遠富貴之形也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形淸神濁，不久貧窮；人小聲洪，定須超越。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445163555","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形貌清而神氣困濁者，時雖貧窘，滯氣若退，福吉還來。○形貌雖小而聲音洪亮，本源盛大。終主發達之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭面寛厚，福祿雙全；神氣澄淸，利名雙得。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483481606","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頭圓象天，皮肉寛厚，富貴之相，豈無福壽乎？澄清而不昏暗者，富貴之相也，亦主喜吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面皮綳急，壽促無疑；骨格恢弘，前程可靠。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483497990","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"面肉浮薄皮膚皺，固非壽相；骨格豐隆，五岳分明者，富貴可期也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956612028481577"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少肥氣短，難過四九之期；唇縮神癡，焉保三旬之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445179939","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年少而體肥，氣喘而促急者，主壽夭。○唇反縮而露齒，目無神而如痴。亦不壽之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形體侷促，作事猥𤠠，氣宇軒昻，一生快順。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445196323","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"體貌侷縮者，作爲必不寛舒；心廣體胖者，無往而不利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻梁露骨，名爲破祖刑家；背脊成坑，號曰虗花無壽。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483514374","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻梁薄削，露骨如劍脊，主破祖業。○背脊欲隆厚，若薄䧟而成坑者，定是花多實少，又主不壽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻有三曲，不賣屋，則賣田。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483530758","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面見兩凹，必成家而成業。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445212707","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼻梁有三曲而不平直者，破敗之人也。天地相朝太華竝拱。發興成立之形也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獐頭鼠目，何必求官；馬面蛇睛，須遭横死。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445229091","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956755192643619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頭削而骨露，曰獐頭，眼凹而睛圓者，曰鼠目，皆爲不貴。○聲嘶而面長曰馬面。目凹而睛紅，曰蛇睛。其性粗心毒，弟兄不義，卒至橫禍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睛靑口濶，文筆高人；","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445245475","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面大頥豐，錢財滿屋。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445245475","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"目睛如㸃漆，口濶若抹丹，文章之士也。○面方而大頭豐而濶者，富家之子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"語言多泛，爲人心事難明，容貌溫和，作事襟懷洒落。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445261859","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"語言貴乎有倫序者，言無綂緒，語言濫泛者，必𡚶。而無實，故許負有云：語言泛濫。作事多亂。其心事豈易明白哉！○形容如美玉之温潤，氣宇似春。風之柔和者，乃襟懷洒落，有德之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨粗髪重，何曾剰得一錢；體細身輕，那得停留片瓦。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445278243","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"骨髪粗而露，頭毛厚而鬆者，貧寒之相，而身連邅也。○身體貴平穩厚重若行如風擺柳葉者，不夭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956612028547113"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨鰲人海，必作尚書；龍骨揷天，應爲宰轉。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445294627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：額骨入天庭，宰相位尊崇。○日月角有骨挿入。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天庭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三公，輔弼之器也，巨鰲卽額骨，龍骨卽日月角也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月角聳，必佐明君；文武雙全，定爲刺史。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445311011","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日月角聳，卽龍骨也，定爲貴相。○若兩觀有骨接邊定者，曰文武雙全，亦牧伯之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼三角狠毒孤刑，鼻帶兩凹，破財疾苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445327395","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼為日月，宜圓明，不宜三角。相有如此，其心不善，婦人主刑夫兒。男子必尅妻子也。○鼻乃土星年□居之。若兩凹侵破，不惟□□，又兼疾苦而貧敗也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445343779","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956786435981347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□□□梗，必是庸常；眉秀神和，須知閒雅。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445360163","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"□□削而輕，手指粗而硬者，庸俗之人。○眉□淸秀，乃神氣温和者，不貴則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"淸閒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□□無韵，何得榮華。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445376547","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"膚澁少光，終無安逸。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445392931","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"□貴平清亮，若粗乾如破羅之音，無韵者，亦□貧也。○皮膚粗澀，又無光潤，主辛苦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□蹄十惡，皆因眼下睛黃，死在九州。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483547142","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢謂齦披唇膘。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445409315","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"犯十惡之凶罪者，多因眼有赤縷，睛黃而不黒色也。○身死于他方者，多爲齒艱掀露口唇不膘也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形神不蘊，貧夭兩全。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483563526","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筋骨莫藏，懦愚雙得。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445425699","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若形有餘，面神不足，或神有餘而形不足，曰不藴。如此之人，不刑則夭。○筋中顯骨，骨中露筋，骨筋俱露而不藏者，不懦弱則愚鹵之夫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956612028612649"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼光嘴趫，爲人執抝不良；齒齧頭揺，其性奸貪無比。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483579910","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"目露睛光，嘴薄唇趫，兼此三者，不良村强之徒也。咬牙作聲曰：齒齧咬牙而揺首擺頭，狠毒之相，必多奸貪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得意中","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445442083","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面容悽慘，先富後貧；遭窘處","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445442083","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顔貌温和，早窮晚發。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445442083","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"利名得意之中，宜喜悅而面容悽慘者，先富而後貧。○若處困窮之間，不憂愁而反溫和者，心量寛洪終必發達，而晩景優游也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金形得金局，逢土可比陶朱。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483596294","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若金形人又得金局之正者，固云金得金，剛毅深矣。兼得土局形氣，則相生而主財富。陶朱公，范蠡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956817033396276"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也，能致富豪。自此以後，論五行之形，今将五行相貌總解於此，後之學者，當熟記而詳察之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水形人","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483612678","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木形人，更宜修長，木性之直，色淸氣秀，得其正也。若腰偏而背薄，非木之善也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火形人","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483629062","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火形人，渾厚上尖，如火之炎，色赤氣枯，得其中也。或衒露浮躁熛灼之過，故風鑑云：一露卽曰火面深卽曰土，似有揭露，皆云火也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氷形人","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483645446","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"圓厚背負，腰圓色玄，氣靜肉重，面清骨輕是也。或筋緩肉流，此謂枝不滿澣，則泛濫而無所守也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金形人","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483661830","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956713375318027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金形人，方而正，骨堅而肉實，隂陽不欺，色白而氣剛，得其中矣。或局促而欹側。骨少而肉多，則柔弱而不堅剛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土形人","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483678214","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土形人而深腰背露，形貌軒昻，肉輕骨重，色黃氣榮，得其稱矣，或管重肉薄，神昏無力，乃淹滯之士也。○若兼形則擇，多者即爲主之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土局得土形見火，有如王愷。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483694598","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若土形人又得土局之正者，固云土得土，當財庫矣。若又兼得火局形氣，則相生亦主財富。王愷與石崇，閉塞者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金人火旺財發，若塵术，主金傷，錢消如土。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483710982","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956848733945871"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金形人得火局，火尅金也。木形人得金局，金尅木也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483727366","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二者形尅之相。廣𨯿云，制尅相形曰：鬼衰，錢財消散。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火逢光彩，帶紅活而愈進家財。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483743750","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火形人得火局之史，固云：火得火，威武大矣。又得紅活之形色，乃火行純一，不爭不奪，貴之次也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水逢黑肥，得圓厚而倍増福壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445474851","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水形人得水局之稱，固云外得水，文學貴矣。又得圓厚之體貌，乃水行純一，不爭不奪，次貴之相，主福祿也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火人帶木，必定榮超。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445491235","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若上小下濶，聲音焦烈，初年稍當者，火形人也。若聲音清秀，瘦直而露骨者，帶木局也，木能生火，超","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956713375350795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"榮之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水局得金，終須快暢。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445507619","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形貌肥圓背負者，固水形人也。若骨兼方正，色白氣剛者，得金局也。金能生水，主一生發逹而無困滞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土逢乙本帶潤澤，亦可䟽通。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445524003","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土形得木，固相尅而非吉矣。若土多木少，氣色潤澤，亦䟽通之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木遇微金，必","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483760134","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0174/27/ref/1lvqvq6z3wefd/1-7603979427814653988_%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%875.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1778112000&x-signature=LbN4GmItandySz1hXThk96Snfy0%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0174/27/ref/1lvqvq6z3wefd/1-7603979427814653988_图片5.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":"7603979427814686756"},"logicSentenceId":"7606693540483760134","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"削，方成器用。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483760134","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木形得金，固相尅而非吉矣。若木多金少，形貌軒昻，必斵削而後成。材器也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水逢厚土，忽破資財；火得微金，卒難進益。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483776518","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956882204508175"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土旣尅其水，又土多而水少，破財無疑。火旣尅金又火重而金微，進益實難也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當看氣色之往來，兼觀紋痣之凶吉，更審運限之長短。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483792902","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此三者與前五行生尅相參而觀之，則吉凶無遺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"額爲火宿，管前三十載之榮枯；鼻乃財星，遇中五六年之休咎。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445540387","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"額主初限，若方正隆厚則吉。尖削斷凹則凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承漿地閣，管盡末年；髪際印堂，周維百歲。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445556771","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"承漿地閣主末限，若豐厚朝拱吉，尖削短小者凶。○髪際及印堂，主一生貴賤。詳見前註。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956713375383563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平生造化，當首取於四強；人世玄機，須先觀夫三主。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483809286","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四强，子午卯酉，卽額、頦、兩觀，後是也，宜豐隆廣濶，不宜尖削破䧟。人生造化，先觀此四者，○三主，卽初、中、末限是也。前文已解，又《成和子篇》分五行之刑，爲三限，其詳也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣色明潤，固爲快順；限歩崎嶇，亦多蹇利。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445573155","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行並三限之步運，若屈限，亦多否雜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭尖額窄，固不可以求官；色慘神枯，兼何由而發跡。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483825670","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼光如鼠，似偷盜之徒；睛竄若獐，如橫亡之漢。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445589539","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼠眼光綻露，暗中能見物。人眼似此，必主穿窬之輩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼凸如蜂目，亦生凶刑；口匾似鮎魚，終須困乏。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445605923","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956913452023823"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上言前五行之形，有七體貌。亦主貧賤孤夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲僧者，頭圓必貴；作道者，貌淸可榮。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483842054","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自此以下，數條皆論僧道之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頂突頭圓，必住名境；神淸骨秀，須加師號。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483858438","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頭圓而頂骨高突，額濶而印堂方正。爲僧必主都綱，眼神清如巖電。骨格秀若龜鶴，爲道者必稱師號矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重頥碧眼，當貴高僧；廣額秀肩，文章道士。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445622307","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"重頥主富，碧眼主性慧也。○額濶而睂秀者，文章之相也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳白過面，善士之封；顴聳印平，天師之爵。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483874822","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956713375416331"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲僧者，耳白於面，必封善世之官。爲道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"觀與印平，必得天師之職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形貌匾促，庸俗之徒；聲骨澄清，富貴之輩。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445638691","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若僧道形貌匾淺者，俗魯○聲骨淸秀者，富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨粗形俗，其人老困山林；形異神殊，此軰遠超雲路。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445655075","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若骨格粗露，形貌塵俗者，終老山林之相也。○形貌秀異者，修行道人不到處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰背豐滿，衣鉢有餘；鼻準直齊，富貴自足。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445671459","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"腰背豐滿，鼻準直齊，皆富貴相也。僧道同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髪𩯭濃重，合道貌，聲響始榮；眉目平直，入僧相，骨淸方貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445687843","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956913452318735"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"髮鬓濃重竒異，既爲道貌，更聲音響亮，見早年榮華。○骨平而秀，目直而朗，旣爲僧相，更若骨法清古，方是尊貴之相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"視瞻不正，必定好淫；舉止多輕，須知貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483891206","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若倫瞻竊視而不正者，其心奸淫，僧道亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼若桃花光焰，但圖酒色歡娛；面如灰土塵朦，定主家財破敗。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483907590","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼神光蕩若桃花色者，奸心丙蒙之相，酒色狂淫之徒也。僧道可知。○面色如灰土，氣色又若塵矇者，貧厄之相也，在僧道，亦主破財疾厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論限運，與俗一同，細辨根基，各求其妙。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483923974","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956713375449099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相中限運，僧道與俗人則同。若部位骨脉色以僧道俗人基本論之，則各求其妙也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生富貴，皆由前世修行；士處貧窮，盡是今生作惡。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445704227","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未觀形，先相心田入之。富貴貧賤，固在於相貌氣色，然作善降祥，作惡降殃，而心田又不可不知也。昔裴度有相者，相云：爾貌不豐，爾形無相。胡爲公？胡爲相？一㸃靈丹。貴莫狀。是知心也，此乃相之大者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若間前程，先要觀乎氣色，欲求仙兆，次則辯其形容，先以五岳爲根基，後以氣色定禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483940358","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言相人之法，先察此四者，吉凶貴賤可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大則活人性命，小則救人難厄。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483956742","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956978933563432"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相法，小而言之，預知吉凶，可以使人避凶趨吉；大而言之，决知生死，如師德上舟而凶。人免溺，可以使人免福獲福矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不爲世見隂功，亦作來生道果。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483973126","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"學相者，窮通此理，其術有益於人。其報亦及乎已也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"志超雲处，上合天機。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540483989510","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"麻衣言：既通出世之術，妙合天機之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眞乃神仙之術，豈虛語哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽夭窮通，莫逃相法，富貴貧賤，奚出此篇。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445720611","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明智者得之，自有神仙之見，智術之士，能精此篇，兼得師傳，非仙而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後之學者，勿傳庸俗之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445736995","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956713375481867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"風鑑之術，于變萬化，窮通物理，豈庸夫俗子之流，所能學哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高山流水少知音，一榻白雲在深處。","logicSentenceId":"7606693540484005894","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此篇譬如高山流水之操，尹音者鮮矣。乆隱於華山石室。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白雲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"深處，今遇知音希夷，故默而授之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"悉精妙理，叅透玄關，得之於心，應之於目，一覽無遺，方知神異賦之不誣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580342172445753379","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"苟能悉精此□之妙理，叅透其中之玄關，了然於心目之間而無遣，方知神異賦之妙。信不誣矣。後之學者，當敬授兹篇，不可以其易而忽之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相法百家歸一理，文字泛多難以揆。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410601499","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刪出諸家奥妙歌，盡與後人容易記。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410617883","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六害睂心親義絕，纔如秋月圓還缺。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410634267","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅妻害子老不閒，作事弄巧反成拙。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410650651","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山根斷兮早虚花，祖業飄零足破家，兄弟無緣離祖宅，老來轉見事如麻。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410667035","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂高面黑神憔悴，愛管他人事掛懷。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410683419","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冷眼","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410699803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956854597566505"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見人笑一面，不知毒在暗中來。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410699803","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乍逢滿座有精神，久看原來色轉昏。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410716187","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似此之人終壽短，縱然有壽亦孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410732571","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五星列曜在人面，除睂之外怡偏斜。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410748955","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳偏口側，末年破。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410765339","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼻曲迎突四十年。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410781723","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讀盡詩書生得寒，文章千載不爲官。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410798107","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平生雖有衝天志，爭奈鶯雛翼未乾。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410814491","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面大眉寒正秀才，唇掀齒露更以災。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410830875","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終朝脚跡忙忙走，富貴平生不帶來。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410847259","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上停短兮下停長，多成多敗値空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410863643","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱然營得成家計，猶如烈日照氷霜，下停短兮上停長，必爲宰相侍君王。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410880027","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是庶人生得此，金珠財寶滿倉箱。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410896411","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957172827914280"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形愛恢弘又怕肥，恢主榮華肥死期。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410912795","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十之上肥定死，四十形恢定發時。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410929179","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瘦自痩兮寒自寒，寒瘦之人不一般。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410945563","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"痩有精神終必達，寒雖形彩定孤單。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410961947","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色怕嫩兮又怕嬌，氣嬌神嫩不相饒。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410978331","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老年色嫩招辛苦，少年色嫩不堅牢。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300410994715","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂要曲兮不要直，曲直愚人不得知。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411011099","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲者多學又聰俊，直者刑妻又尅兒。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411027483","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髭髯要黑又要稀，依稱見肉始爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411043867","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最嫌濃濁焦黄色，父在東頭子在西，議論爭差識者稀，附子金鎻號銀匙。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411060251","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂高性巧能通變，侍待王公在此時。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411076635","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330956854597599273"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"銀匙歌股肱無毛最是卤，兩頭如杖一般同。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411093019","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有祖田并父廕，終須破敗受貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411109403","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭痕瘢剥最爲刑，羅網之中有一名。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411125787","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不兢妻并害子，更憂家道主俗信。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411142171","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相中最忌興君面，男子郎君命不長。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411158555","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女子郎君好滛慾，僧道孤門却無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411174939","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂毛間斷至額邊，𡮢爲官非賣却田。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411191323","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅破妻子三兩祻，方教個患不相纒。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411207707","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好色之人眼帶花，莫教眼緊視人斜。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411224091","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有毒無毒但看眼。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411240475","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇眼之人子打爺。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411256859","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無家可靠羊睛眼，却問他人借住塲。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411273243","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有禾倉高二","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411289627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957206961127464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寸，中年猶未","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411289627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有夫娘。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411289627","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼下凹時又主孤，陽空隂没亦同途。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411322395","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯西不如鷄卵様，只冝養子與同居。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411338779","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下頭尖了作㐫殃，典却田國更賣塘。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411355163","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任是張良能計策，自然顚倒見狼當。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411371547","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼珠暴出惡因縁，自主家時定賣田。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411387931","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有白睛包一半，也知不𣦸在床前。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411404315","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

pe":1,"content":"髪際低而㓜無父，寒毛生𧢲㓜無娘。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411568155","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左顴骨出父先死，不𣦸不刑便自傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411584539","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士人𦕈眼𨺻文星，豹齒失頭定没名。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411600923","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任是文童過北斗，拾如木履不安釘。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411617307","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睂重山根陷破財，更憂三十二年災。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411633691","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土星端正終須發，土星不好去無囬。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411650075","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寒相之人肩過頸，享福之人耳壓眉。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411666459","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有親戚檯不出，只因形似雨中鷄。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411682843","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大量之人睂高眼，眼睂相定不憂悲。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411699227","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眉粗","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411715611","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330957236627488783"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼細不相當，寅年吃了卯年糧。","logicSentenceId":"7580388300411715611","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○眼丄肉生龍宮福堂，氣盤旋者，隂德之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845589418036","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春印光","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810094120","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963579816083491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一色如錢大者，主得財，七旬内應。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810094120","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○地閣黄光，主入宅之喜及進業之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810110504","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○鼻上黄光如柳葉，橫發者，主横財人門。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810126888","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○四煞上有色潤，行岳勝，黑色㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810159656","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○甲匱有黄色入句，日内有財喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810176040","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄入正口，主患天行疾，承漿喜，外甥主遠行，夀上主壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810192424","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○山根常黄，司空常有，並主喜。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810208808","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中陽有，先㐫後吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810225192","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○日下爲房中喜，春發黃光，左生男，右生女，喜女人有此亦無有。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810290728","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330963617053032487"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○人中有者，主多年遠信至。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810323496","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏在目及眉上，主得道。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810339880","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏在眼下，主子孫有喜色連鼻直上，三十日内得","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810356264","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財，夏季發法令。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810356264","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外色偏面，主父母妻子喜慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810389032","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○婦人印堂上黄，橫過者，二","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810421800","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"品妻位，兼生貴子，形厚紫黄，人達晚膚薄色黃，少昌","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810421800","marginNoteIdList":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580339845810421800","marginNoteIdList":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
